explication: This OCA repository is a suite of Odoo helpdesk addons centered on ticket intake, assignment, tracking, and resolution. The principal workflow accepts tickets through the customer portal or mail gateway, creates and assigns tickets, and tracks them through teams and stages; addons extend this with SLA and stage controls, customer feedback, and links to CRM, projects, sales, and field service. The graph combines sampled controller/model behavior with major capabilities stated in the README; links for unsampled addon internals are omitted where wiring is not established.
